news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will release summarized Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00am ET. This formalizes the next scheduled checkpoint on whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp seen in Q1 2026 continued into the second quarter.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a Q2 2026 dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock payable entirely in new common shares (roughly 80,463 shares, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38) rather than cash, to holders of record as of July 21, 2026, with payment settling July 29, 2026. Paying the dividend in stock preserves cash but modestly dilutes common shareholders.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Director Elections and Equity Plan Expansion at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting, NeurAxis stockholders elected all six director nominees (including CEO Brian Carrico) and approved expanding the 2022 Omnibus Incentive Plan's authorized share pool from 1,482,152 to 3,400,000 shares plus a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Stockholders also ratified Rosenberg Rich Baker Berman, P.A. as the company's independent auditor.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record First Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 80% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis posted record Q1 2026 revenue of about $1.6 million, up 80% year over year, its seventh consecutive quarter of double-digit growth, with gross margin expanding to roughly 86.4% following the new Category I CPT reimbursement code for PENFS that took effect January 1, 2026. Net loss narrowed about 22% year over year to $1.95 million and quarterly cash burn improved to $1.2 million from $1.6 million a year earlier.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with Four New Medical Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced four additional health insurers adopted medical policies covering its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy, adding roughly 1.25 million newly covered lives across West Virginia, New Hampshire, South Carolina, Virginia and Florida. This continued the post-CPT-code pattern of incremental reimbursement wins expanding the device's insured patient base.

news.headline: NeurAxis CEO and CFO Buy Shares in Open-Market Purchases
news.summary: CEO Brian Carrico bought 8,060 shares and CFO Timothy Henrichs bought 7,593 shares on the open market on April 1, 2026, both at $1.96 per share, with a smaller purchase by another executive at the same price. The same-day, same-price cluster of insider buys was read by some investors as a signal of management confidence.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open with a 9:00am ET conference call; investors will watch whether the +80% YoY revenue growth and margin expansion seen in Q1 2026 continued and whether cash burn kept trending toward management's sub-$1M/quarter target.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective January 1, 2026) and insurer wins covering about 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a recurring pattern of announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could keep expanding its reimbursed addressable market.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS / expanded pediatric label FDA submissions
catalysts.detail: Management has publicly flagged plans to pursue expanded FDA indications for PENFS beyond the current pediatric/adolescent functional abdominal pain and dyspepsia clearances, including an adult IBS indication; no confirmed submission or clearance date has been disclosed.

catalysts.label: VA hospital system commercial rollout
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis holds a Federal Supply Schedule contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and began its VA commercial push in early 2026; management noted on the Q1 2026 call that VA adoption was running ahead of expectations, and broader uptake across the roughly 180 VA hospitals could become an incremental revenue driver.

pulse: NeurAxis remains in a quiet news stretch heading into its Q2 2026 report: since the June 10 annual meeting (where the board was re-elected and the equity incentive plan was expanded) and a July 9 stock dividend on Series B Preferred shares that settled July 29, the only fresh development has been the July 28 confirmation that Q2 2026 results will be released before market open on August 11, 2026 with a 9:00am ET call. The stock has traded roughly in the $6.50-$7.30 range through June and July (versus a 52-week range of about $2.20-$9.33), well above where it sat before the January 2026 CPT code took effect, reflecting the market's reaction to Q1's 80% YoY revenue growth, expanding gross margins, and narrowing cash burn. The August 11 report is the key near-term event to confirm the reimbursement-driven growth trajectory held up in Q2, with payer coverage expansion, the VA rollout (which management said was ahead of plan as of Q1), and potential adult-indication FDA submissions as the medium-term catalysts to watch.
